annotation.interpretation_a: The condition applies only if the service was *currently* available at a different interface when the loopback connection attempt occurred.
annotation.interpretation_b: The condition applies if the service was available at a different interface *at any point in the past*, even if it is no longer available there.
annotation.justification: The phrase "previously available" is open to interpretation. Does it mean currently available at a different interface, or available at any point in the past? The lack of a temporal constraint creates ambiguity.
annotation.missing_information: The temporal relationship between the service being available at a different interface and the loopback connection attempt is not specified. This affects whether a historical availability should block the loopback connection.
